summary.en: A Florentine of the 13th century known only by his nickname, Ciacco, which early commentators linked to 'hog' or to the name Giacomo. Commentators such as Boccaccio describe him as a witty, well-mannered frequenter of the tables of the rich, but his identity is uncertain.

en: Sometimes identified with the poet Ciacco dell'Anguillara, an identification scholars reject
Boccaccio tells a story about him in the Decameron (IX, 8)
